# Support

ArtCraft WebOS is a volunteer-maintained open-source project with no
support SLAs.

## Where to get help

1. **Docs first** — [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md) is the index.
   Start with the [Quickstart](../docs/getting-started/quickstart.md).
2. **Known issues & status** —
   [docs/planning/PROGRESS.md](../docs/planning/PROGRESS.md) tracks the
   current state, and GitHub Issues may already have your bug.
3. **Questions & bugs** — open a GitHub
   [Issue](https://github.com/aliasfoxkde/ArtCraft-WebOS/issues/new/choose)
   using the question or bug template. Include: browser + version, OS,
   what you did, what you expected, what happened, and console output if
   any.
4. **Security** — do **not** open a public issue. Use
   [private vulnerability reporting](SECURITY.md).

## What to expect

Issues are triaged as maintainer capacity allows; there are no response
time guarantees. The project is experimental — do not store sensitive
information in it.

## Craft apps

For help with an embedded craft app (CADCraft, PhotoCraft, …), open the
issue in that app's own repository (`github.com/aliasfoxkde/<app>`) —
mention WebOS embedding only if the problem is specific to running it
here.
